info.name: OutfitShop SS-MIS API
info.description:
OutfitShop-Backend-API - Monolithic Headless TPS/OLTP REST API.
Base URL: https://api.kesararamwithdigital.tech/api/v1

Access tiers: TIER 1 public (no token), TIER 2 authenticated (Bearer), TIER 3 manager/admin, TIER 4 admin only.

Run folder 00 Login first - each login captures {{token}} plus its role variable. Requests marked [legacy] are deprecated aliases (Sunset 2027-12-31); prefer the canonical route shown alongside.

Rebuilt 2026-08-22 from the live route surface after the full endpoint audit; real production IDs are pre-filled.

Security: login requests reference password variables ({{admin_password}} etc.) - set them locally after obtaining credentials; no passwords are stored in this file.
